title_en: Guangling District People's Procuratorate of Yangzhou City, Jiangsu Province v. Beijing Sunshine Yibai Biotechnology Development Co., Ltd., Xi Wenyou, et al. — dispute over production and sale of toxic and harmful food products

full_text_en:
Guangling District People's Procuratorate of Yangzhou, Jiangsu Province v. Beijing Yangguang Yibai Biotechnology Development Co., Ltd., Xi Wenyou, et al. — case of producing and selling toxic and harmful food

Ruling Summary

The Food Safety Law clearly stipulates that it is prohibited to add chemical substances other than food additives and other substances that may endanger human health to food. Where an actor mixes a chemical substance prohibited by the state into food, and such substance, although not explicitly listed as a toxic or harmful substance in judicial interpretations, has equivalent harm, it shall be determined as a toxic or harmful substance, and the actor shall be convicted and punished according to the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food.

Prosecutor: Guangling District People's Procuratorate of Yangzhou, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant entity: Beijing Yangguang Yibai Biotechnology Development Co., Ltd.

Defendant: Xi Wenyou, male, 48 years old, Han ethnicity, residing in Tongzhou District, Beijing. Actual responsible person for the operation of Beijing Yangguang Yibai Biotechnology Development Co., Ltd. Detained on January 30, 2013 on suspicion of producing and selling toxic and harmful food, arrested on March 7, 2013.

Defendant: Yin Lixin, male, 48 years old, Han ethnicity, residing in Fengtai District, Beijing. Pharmacist at Beijing Chengxintang Pharmacy Co., Ltd. Detained on March 16, 2013 on suspicion of producing and selling toxic and harmful food, arrested on April 19, 2013.

Defendant: Tan Guomin, male, 52 years old, Han ethnicity, residing in Chaoyang District, Beijing. Legal representative of Beijing Jingaotianhua Commerce and Trade Co., Ltd. Detained on March 5, 2013 on suspicion of producing and selling toxic and harmful food, arrested on April 10, 2013.

Defendant: Yang Lifeng, male, 46 years old, Han ethnicity, residing in Lantian County, Shaanxi Province. Production manager of Beijing Yangguang Yibai Biotechnology Development Co., Ltd. Detained on February 22, 2013 on suspicion of producing and selling toxic and harmful food, arrested on March 29, 2013.

Defendant: Zhong Limeng, male, 30 years old, Han ethnicity, residing in Tonghua City, Jilin Province. Sales supervisor of the Shanqi Shen Business Division of Beijing Yangguang Yibai Biotechnology Development Co., Ltd. Detained on March 1, 2013 on suspicion of producing and selling toxic and harmful food, arrested on April 7, 2013.

Defendant: Wang Hailong, male, 33 years old, Han ethnicity, residing in Langfang City, Hebei Province. Northern Region Sales Supervisor of the Shanqi Shen Business Division of Beijing Yangguang Yibai Biotechnology Development Co., Ltd. Detained on January 30, 2013 on suspicion of producing and selling toxic and harmful food, arrested on March 7, 2013.

Guangling District People's Procuratorate of Yangzhou, Jiangsu Province, instituted a public prosecution with the Guangling District People's Court of Yangzhou, Jiangsu Province, against defendant entity Beijing Yangguang Yibai Biotechnology Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Yangguang Yibai Company) and defendants Xi Wenyou, Yin Lixin, Tan Guomin, Yang Lifeng, Zhong Limeng, and Wang Hailong, for the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food.

The indictment alleged: The defendant entity Yangguang Yibai Company and defendant Xi Wenyou, knowing that the Shanqi Shen capsules contained buformin hydrochloride, a substance prohibited from addition by the state, nonetheless produced and sold them; defendant Yang Lifeng, knowing that the Shanqi Shen capsules contained buformin hydrochloride, a substance prohibited from addition by the state, nonetheless produced them; defendants Zhong Limeng and Wang Hailong, knowing that the Shanqi Shen capsules contained buformin hydrochloride and other Western medicines prohibited from addition by the state, nonetheless sold them; defendants Yin Lixin and Tan Guomin, knowing that Xi Wenyou was producing and selling the health food Shanqi Shen capsules containing buformin hydrochloride, a substance prohibited from addition by the state, nonetheless supplied raw materials containing buformin hydrochloride, a substance prohibited from addition by the state. Among them, the circumstances of Xi Wenyou, Yin Lixin, Tan Guomin, Yang Lifeng, and Zhong Limeng were particularly serious, and the circumstances of Wang Hailong were serious. All should be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food. Yin Lixin, Tan Guomin, Zhong Limeng, Yang Lifeng, and Wang Hailong acted jointly with Xi Wenou with common intent, constituting a joint crime; Xi Wenyou, Yin Lixin, and Tan Guomin played principal roles in the joint crime, being principals, and should be punished for all crimes in which they participated; Zhong Limeng, Yang Lifeng, and Wang Hailong played secondary roles in the joint crime, being accessories, and should be given a lighter or mitigated punishment. Tan Guomin and Yang Lifeng voluntarily surrendered and truthfully confessed their criminal facts, constituting voluntary surrender, and may be given a lighter or mitigated punishment. Xi Wenyou, Yin Lixin, and Wang Hailong, after being brought to justice, truthfully confessed their crimes, and may be given a lighter punishment. The court was requested to adjudicate according to law.

The defendant entity, the six defendants, and their defense counsels did not object to the basic fact alleged in the indictment that the Shanqi Shen capsules produced and sold by Yangguang Yibai Company contained buformin hydrochloride. However, they argued that buformin hydrochloride is not a toxic or harmful substance; none of the defendants knew that buformin hydrochloride was a toxic or harmful substance, and subjectively they had no criminal intent; the defendant entity and each defendant did not constitute the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food.

The court of first instance, Guangling District People's Court of Yangzhou, found:

The defendant entity Yangguang Yibai Company was a limited liability company established by registration in 2001. The legal representative registered with the industry and commerce authorities was Xi Wenlong, and the defendant Xi Wenyou was the actual person responsible for its operations. On December 21, 2009, the State Food and Drug Administration issued the "Approval Certificate for Domestic Health Food" to Yangguang Yibai Company, with the product name "Yangguang Yibai brand Shanqi Shen capsules", approval number Guo Shi Jian Zi G20090557, and health function of assisting in lowering blood sugar. Since 2010, Xi Wenyou purchased raw materials for producing Shanqi Shen capsules from defendant Tan Guomin at a price of 600 yuan per kilogram (those raw materials were obtained by defendant Tan Guomin after purchasing them from defendant Yin Lixin and processing them). After purchasing the raw materials, Xi Wenou processed them further into the health food Yangguang Yibai brand Shanqi Shen capsules for assisting in lowering blood sugar, and sold them at a price of about 100 yuan per box to the Jinfuhai Health Products Store in Guangling District, Yangzhou, and to various regions nationwide.

On May 24, 2012, the Shanghai Institute for Food and Drug Control tested samples of Yangguang Yibai brand Shanqi Shen capsules obtained by the Xuhui District Food and Drug Supervision Office from Chen Jiasheng for illegal addition of hypoglycemic drugs, and the result detected glibenclamide. The Xuhui Branch of the Shanghai Food and Drug Administration notified the defendant entity Yangguang Yibai Company in writing of this result on June 8, 2012. On August 9, 2012, the Shenzhen Institute for Drug Control tested samples of Yangguang Yibai brand Shanqi Shen capsules taken by the Hunan Provincial Food and Drug Administration for added hypoglycemic chemical components, and the result detected buformin. The Beijing Municipal Drug Inspection Office served the test report in writing to Xi Wenyou of Yangguang Yibai Company on August 29, 2012, and conducted an on-site inspection of the company. On August 16, 2012, the Shenzhen Institute for Drug Control tested samples of Yangguang Yibai brand Shanqi Shen capsules taken by the Hohhot Municipal Food and Drug Administration for added hypoglycemic chemical components, and the result detected buformin. The Beijing Municipal Drug Inspection Office served the test report in writing to Yangguang Yibai Company on September 11, 2012, and conducted an on-site inspection of the company.

Around the end of August 2012, defendant Xi Wenyou, after learning that the health food Shanqi Shen capsules produced by his company contained buformin, nonetheless continued to produce and sell Yangguang Yibai brand Shanqi Shen capsules containing buformin hydrochloride, a substance prohibited from addition by the state. From the end of August 2012 until the case was discovered in January 2013, the production and sales amount exceeded RMB 8 million.

Defendant Yang Lifeng was the production manager of Yangguang Yibai Company, responsible for the production of the health food Shanqi Shen capsules. On August 31, 2012, the Beijing Municipal Drug Administration visited Yangguang Yibai Company to sample and test Shanqi Shen capsules for the presence of buformin. Yang Lifeng signed the sampling record and, following instructions from defendant Xi Wenyou, denied to the inspectors that the Shanqi Shen capsules in which buformin had been detected were products of Yangguang Yibai Company. Xi Wenyou provided sample products prepared for inspection that did not contain buformin. Yang Lifeng, after knowing that the health food Shanqi Shen capsules produced by his company contained buformin, nonetheless continued production. From the end of August 2012 until the case was discovered in January 2013, the production amount exceeded RMB 8 million.

Defendant Zhong Limeng, as the sales supervisor of the Shanqi Shen Business Division of the defendant entity Yangguang Yibai Company, was responsible for sales in the southern market. On August 29, 2012, Changsha distributor Zhang Yinsheng sent to Zhong Limeng's email the test report from the Shenzhen Institute for Drug Control which detected buformin in Shanqi Shen capsules. Later, Zhong Limeng was dispatched by Xi Wenyou to Changsha to handle the matter. Defendant Wang Hailong was the Northern Region Sales Supervisor of the Shanqi Shen Business Division of Yangguang Yibai Company, responsible for sales in the northern market. On January 5, 2013, the Beijing Municipal Drug Inspection authorities, together with the Yangzhou Institute for Drug Control's test report for Yangguang Yibai brand Shanqi Shen capsules which had detected buformin hydrochloride, conducted an inspection at Yangguang Yibai Company. Wang Hailong photographed the test report with his mobile phone and informed Zhong Limeng about it on the same day. Wang Hailong and Zhong Limeng continued to sell Shanqi Shen capsules after knowing that the product produced by Yangguang Yibai Company contained buformin hydrochloride. From the end of August 2012 to September 12, 2012, and from January 6, 2013 to January 21, 2013, the sales amount for the southern market under Zhong Limeng's responsibility totaled over RMB 400,000. From January 6, 2013 to January 21, 2013, the sales amount for the northern market under Wang Hailong's responsibility totaled over RMB 400,000.

Around early September 2012, defendants Tan Guomin and Yin Lixin, after learning that the raw materials they supplied were used by the defendant entity Yangguang Yibai Company to produce Shanqi Shen capsules, and that buformin had been detected in the product, nonetheless continued to supply to defendant Xi Wenyou raw materials containing buformin hydrochloride, a substance prohibited from addition by the state, for the company's production and sale of Shanqi Shen capsules. Yin Lixin also provided to Tan Guomin the production ratios and the ratios used by manufacturers for the health product Shanqi Shen capsules, and Tan Guomin then communicated these ratio requirements to Xi Wenyou. From September 2012 until the case was discovered in January 2013, the amount of Shanqi Shen capsules containing buformin hydrochloride produced and sold by the company exceeded RMB 8 million. Among this, Tan Guomin sold raw materials to Xi Wenyou from September 2012 until the case was discovered in the amount of RMB 1.32 million, and Yin Lixin sold raw materials to Tan Guomin from September 2012 until the case was discovered in the amount of RMB 671,500.

Buformin hydrochloride is the hydrochloride salt of buformin. Expert opinions provided by Professor Ge Xiaoqun from the Medical College of Yangzhou University and the appraisal opinion from the Judicial Appraisal Institute of Nanjing Medical University proved: Buformin hydrochloride has the effect of lowering blood sugar, but it was withdrawn from the Chinese market long ago. Long-term use of health foods containing added buformin hydrochloride may have adverse effects on the body, and may even be life-threatening. Currently, buformin hydrochloride has not been approved for production or import by the drug regulatory authority of the State Council, and it may not be produced, sold, or used as a drug in China. On June 3, 2011, the State Food and Drug Administration issued an approval document for supplementary testing methods and testing items, numbered 2011008, titled in Chinese: "Supplementary testing method for the illegal addition of buformin hydrochloride in hypoglycemic traditional Chinese patent medicines and health foods". This supplementary testing method is applicable for rapid screening and confirmation of the illegal addition of the chemical drug buformin hydrochloride in hypoglycemic traditional Chinese patent medicines and health foods.

The court of first instance, Guangling District People's Court of Yangzhou, held:

The defendant entity Yangguang Yibai Company and defendant Xi Wenyou, as the directly responsible person in charge for the production and sale of Shanqi Shen capsules by Yangguang Yibai Company, and defendants Yang Lifeng, Zhong Limeng, and Wang Hailong, as direct responsible persons for the production and sale of Shanqi Shen capsules by Yangguang Yibai Company, knowing that the health food Shanqi Shen capsules produced and sold by Yangguang Yibai Company contained buformin hydrochloride, a substance prohibited from addition by the state, nonetheless produced and sold them. Defendants Yin Lixin and Tan Guomin, knowing that the raw materials they supplied containing buformin hydrochloride, a substance prohibited from addition by the state, were used by Xi Wenyou to produce the health food Shanqi Shen capsules for sale. Among them, Yangguang Yibai Company, Xi Wenyou, Yin Lixin, and Tan Guomin participated in the production and sale of Shanqi Shen capsules containing buformin hydrochloride in an amount exceeding RMB 8 million; Yang Lifeng participated in the production of Shanqi Shen capsules containing buformin hydrochloride in an amount exceeding RMB 8 million. The above defendant entity and defendants all had other particularly serious circumstances. Zhong Limeng and Wang Hailong participated in the sale of Shanqi Shen capsules containing buformin hydrochloride in an amount exceeding RMB 400,000; the above two defendants both had other serious circumstances. The acts of Yangguang Yibai Company, Xi Wenyou, Yin Lixin, and Tan Guomin all constituted the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food; the act of Yang Lifeng constituted the crime of producing toxic and harmful food; the acts of Zhong Limeng and Wang Hailong constituted the crime of selling toxic and harmful food.

Defendants Yin Lixin and Tan Guomin jointly and intentionally committed crimes with defendant Xi Wenyou, constituting a joint crime. Yin Lixin and Tan Guomin were accessories in the joint crime, and should be given a lighter punishment according to law. Xi Wenyou jointly and intentionally committed crimes with defendants Yang Lifeng, Zhong Limeng, and Wang Hailong, constituting a joint crime. Yang Lifeng, Zhong Limeng, and Wang Hailong were accessories, and should be given a mitigated punishment according to law. Xi Wenyou played a principal role in the joint crime, being a principal, and should be punished for all crimes he organized and directed.

Defendants Yang Lifeng and Tan Guomin voluntarily surrendered and voluntarily confessed in court, so both may be given a lighter punishment according to law. Defendants Xi Wenyou, Yin Lixin, and Wang Hailong truthfully confessed the criminal facts after being brought to justice and voluntarily confessed in court, so they may all be given a lighter punishment according to law. Defendant Zhong Limeng truthfully confessed part of the criminal facts after being brought to justice and voluntarily confessed to that part in court, so a lighter punishment may be given for that part.

In summary, in accordance with Articles 144, 141(1), 150, 31, 56(1), 25(1), 26(1) and (4), 27, 67(1) and (3), and 64 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, and Articles 6(1), 7, and 9(1) and (3) of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Handling of Criminal Cases of Endangering Food Safety, the Guangling District People's Court of Yangzhou, on January 10, 2014, adjudged:

1. Defendant entity Beijing Yangguang Yibai Biotechnology Development Co., Ltd. was guilty of the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food and was fined RMB 15 million;

2. Defendant Xi Wenyou was guilty of the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food and was sentenced to 15 years' imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for 3 years, and a fine of RMB 9 million;

3. Defendant Yin Lixin was guilty of the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food and was sentenced to 12 years' imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for 2 years, and a fine of RMB 1 million;

4. Defendant Tan Guomin was guilty of the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food and was sentenced to 11 years' imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for 2 years, and a fine of RMB 1 million;

5. Defendant Yang Lifeng was guilty of the crime of producing toxic and harmful food and was sentenced to 5 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 100,000;

6. Defendant Zhong Limeng was guilty of the crime of selling toxic and harmful food and was sentenced to 4 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 80,000;

7. Defendant Wang Hailong was guilty of the crime of selling toxic and harmful food and was sentenced to 3 years and 6 months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 60,000;

8. Further recovery of illegal gains in the amount of RMB 8 million from the defendant entity Beijing Yangguang Yibai Biotechnology Development Co., Ltd.; recovery of illegal gains in the amount of RMB 671,500 from defendant Yin Lixin; and recovery of illegal gains in the amount of RMB 1.32 million from defendant Tan Guomin;

9. The seized Shanqi Shen capsules and granules containing buformin hydrochloride were ordered to be confiscated.

Yangguang Yibai Company and Xi Wenyou and the other five persons all refused to accept the first-instance judgment and appealed to the Yangzhou Intermediate People's Court, arguing: None of the six persons subjectively knew that buformin hydrochloride was a toxic or harmful substance; the evidence in the original judgment that determined buformin hydrochloride to be a toxic or harmful substance was insufficient; Yangguang Yibai Company and Xi Wenyou and the other five persons did not constitute the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food. The defense counsel for appellant Xi Wenyou also argued that Xi Wenyou's acts constituted the crime of producing and selling counterfeit drugs.

The Yangzhou Intermediate People's Court, upon second instance, confirmed the facts found by the first-instance court.

The Yangzhou Intermediate People's Court held in the second instance:

Regarding the appeal opinions and defense arguments of the appellant entity, each appellant, and their defense counsels that buformin hydrochloride is not a toxic or harmful substance, and that the appellant entity and each appellant do not constitute the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food: Upon examination, buformin hydrochloride is a chemical substance that has not been approved for production or import by the drug regulatory authority in China, and may not be produced, sold, or used as a drug in China. It has the same attributes as drugs on the state's list of prohibited drugs and is prohibited from use as a drug in China. It is also not a food additive and is a substance prohibited from being added or used in food production and business activities. Although it is not on the state's directly determined list of toxic and harmful substances, it has equivalent harm to the human body as other hypoglycemic Western medicines on that list, and therefore should be determined as a toxic or harmful substance. The appellant entity's addition of this prohibited substance to health food constitutes the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food. Therefore, these appeal opinions and defense arguments cannot be established and are not adopted.

Regarding the defense argument by the defense counsel for appellant Xi Wenyou that Xi Wenyou's acts constitute the crime of producing and selling counterfeit drugs: Upon examination, Shanqi Shen capsules are a health food. Their stated main ingredients are food raw materials that are both medicine and food, and Chinese herbal raw materials that can be used in health food. The auxiliary hypoglycemic function indicated to consumers for Shanqi Shen capsules refers to the auxiliary therapeutic function of the food raw materials that are both medicine and food and the Chinese herbal raw materials themselves, not the therapeutic function of Western medicines. The instructions and promotional materials for Shanqi Shen capsules clearly inform consumers that the product does not contain Western medicines or any other prohibited ingredients, and cannot replace medicine, i.e., Western medicines. Therefore, the acts of appellant Xi Wenyou do not meet the constitutive elements of the crime of producing and selling counterfeit drugs. Therefore, this defense argument cannot be established and is not adopted.

Regarding the appeal opinions and defense arguments of the appellant entity, each appellant, and their defense counsels that each appellant did not know that buformin hydrochloride was a toxic or harmful substance and lacked the criminal intent for the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food: Upon examination, each appellant, as food producers and operators, knew that chemical substances other than food additives cannot be added to health food. After successively learning that the Shanqi Shen capsules they produced and sold contained buformin hydrochloride, and knowing that buformin hydrochloride is a prohibited substance with Western medicine attributes that cannot be added to health food, they nonetheless continued production and sale. Subjectively, they all had the criminal intent for the crime of producing and selling toxic and harmful food. Therefore, these appeal opinions and defense arguments cannot be established and are not adopted.

In summary, in accordance with Article 225(1)(i) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Yangzhou Intermediate People's Court, on June 13, 2014, ruled:

Appeal dismissed; the original judgment was affirmed.

This ruling is final.
